name: receipt-image
description: A finished receipt image (Studio's art, PNG) prints in from a fixed top edge over about 3 s, then holds. The image is shown as drawn: never recolored, cropped or scaled past the safe area.

image.note: PNG, absolute or relative to the episode folder

image_9x16.note: optional PNG for 9:16 only (e.g. Studio's 2x strip, scaled down to fit); default: image

hold.note: seconds to hold after the print, default 2.0
